// census-want: 1
// Review 2 probe B: the blockFunc parameter copied into a local variable and
// that variable started as a goroutine after the lease went back.
package oai

import "github.com/GottZ/ctx/internal/dispatch"

func (r subBlockRun) relay(do blockFunc, lease *dispatch.Lease) {
	g := do
	lease.Release()
	go g(0, 0, 1, lease, nil, 0)
}
